"/></div><div class="partner-logo mlabs"><img alt="mLabs" src="data:image/png;base64,"/></div></div></div></div></div><div class="wrap footer-bottom"><div></div><div class="footer-disclaimer">MIV · Marketing · Inteligência · Vendas</div><div class="footer-cnpj">MAIS IDEIAS LTDA • CNPJ 53.668.468/0001-15</div></div></footer>
<script>
    const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries)=>{ entries.forEach(entry=>{ if(entry.isIntersecting){ entry.target.classList.add('is-visible'); observer.unobserve(entry.target); } }); }, { threshold: 0.14 });
    document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>observer.observe(el));
    const body = document.body; const burger = document.querySelector('.hamburger'); const mobileLinks = document.querySelectorAll('.mobile-menu a');
    if(burger) burger.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ body.classList.toggle('menu-open'); burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded', body.classList.contains('menu-open') ? 'true' : 'false'); });
    mobileLinks.forEach(link=>link.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ body.classList.remove('menu-open'); if(burger) burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false'); }));
  </script>
<script>
(()=>{
  const reduce=window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  const clamp=(n,min,max)=>Math.max(min,Math.min(max,n));

  // Flow story: each of the five cards receives a full scroll phase.
  const flowRoot=document.querySelector('[data-flow-story]');
  const flowSteps=[...document.querySelectorAll('[data-flow-step]')];
  function updateFlow(){
    if(!flowRoot||!flowSteps.length||window.innerWidth<1025)return;
    const r=flowRoot.getBoundingClientRect(),vh=window.innerHeight;
    const travel=Math.max(1,r.height-vh);
    const p=clamp((-r.top)/travel,0,1);
    const idx=Math.min(flowSteps.length-1,Math.floor(p*flowSteps.length));
    flowSteps.forEach((el,i)=>{el.classList.toggle('story-active',i===idx);el.classList.toggle('story-past',i<idx);});
    flowRoot.classList.toggle('note-active',idx>=2);
  }

  // Two-phase comparison: traditional first, MIV overlays second.
  const compare=document.querySelector('[data-compare-scroll]');
  function updateCompare(){
    if(!compare||window.innerWidth<1025)return;
    const r=compare.getBoundingClientRect(),vh=window.innerHeight;
    const travel=Math.max(1,r.height-vh);
    const p=clamp((-r.top)/travel,0,1);
    compare.classList.toggle('phase-one',p>.03);
    compare.classList.toggle('phase-two',p>.44);
  }

  // Progressive overlay for "Da leitura à evolução".
  // Card 01 rises naturally with the section. Once centered, the sticky stage holds it.
  // Cards 02–06 then rise from below and stop exactly over the previous card.
  // After card 06, the sticky container reaches its end and the whole stack scrolls away.
  const howScroll=document.querySelector('[data-how-scroll]');
  const howCards=howScroll?[...howScroll.querySelectorAll('[data-how-card]')]:[];
  function updateHowScroll(){
    if(!howScroll||!howCards.length)return;
    if(window.innerWidth<1025){
      howCards.forEach(card=>{
        card.style.removeProperty('--stack-y');
        card.style.removeProperty('z-index');
      });
      return;
    }

    const vh=window.innerHeight;
    const r=howScroll.getBoundingClientRect();
    // Scroll consumed while the 100vh stage is actually pinned.
    const pinnedScroll=clamp(-r.top,0,Math.max(0,howScroll.offsetHeight-vh));

    // Each new card gets a short beat with the previous one centered, then rises.
    const beat=vh*.18;
    const rise=vh*.42;
    const step=beat+rise; // 60vh per new card
    const startY=vh*1.06; // fully below the viewport/stage

    howCards.forEach((card,i)=>{
      let y=0;
      if(i>0){
        const start=(i-1)*step+beat;
        const t=clamp((pinnedScroll-start)/rise,0,1);
        // Smooth deceleration as the card reaches the center.
        const eased=1-Math.pow(1-t,3);
        y=(1-eased)*startY;
      }
      card.style.setProperty('--stack-y',`${y.toFixed(2)}px`);
      card.style.zIndex=String(21+i);
    });
  }

  // Sticky method image story.
  function initStory(rootSelector,chapterSelector,frameSelector){
    const root=document.querySelector(rootSelector); if(!root)return;
    const chapters=[...root.querySelectorAll(chapterSelector)],frames=[...root.querySelectorAll(frameSelector)];
    const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{entries.forEach(entry=>{if(!entry.isIntersecting)return;const idx=Number(entry.target.dataset.index||0);chapters.forEach((c,i)=>c.classList.toggle('active',i===idx));frames.forEach((f,i)=>f.classList.toggle('active',i===idx));});},{rootMargin:'-38% 0px -38% 0px',threshold:.01});
    chapters.forEach(ch=>observer.observe(ch));
  }
  initStory('[data-cinema-story]','[data-story-chapter]','[data-cinema-frame]');

  // Controlled SDR parallax, preserving the face on the right.
  const sdr=document.querySelector('.sdr-band');
  function updateParallax(){
    if(!sdr||reduce||window.innerWidth<1025)return;
    const r=sdr.getBoundingClientRect(); if(r.bottom<0||r.top>window.innerHeight)return;
    const p=clamp((window.innerHeight-r.top)/(window.innerHeight+r.height),0,1);
    sdr.style.backgroundPosition=`${57+p*3}% ${48+p*4}%`;
  }

  // Proof counters.
  const counterObserver=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{entries.forEach(entry=>{if(!entry.isIntersecting||entry.target.dataset.done)return;const el=entry.target;el.dataset.done='1';const target=Number(el.dataset.counter||0),prefix=el.dataset.prefix||'',suffix=el.dataset.suffix||'';if(reduce){el.textContent=prefix+String(target).replace('.',',')+suffix;return;}const start=performance.now(),dur=1100;function tick(now){const t=clamp((now-start)/dur,0,1),e=1-Math.pow(1-t,3),v=target*e;let out=target%1===0?Math.round(v).toString():v.toFixed(1).replace('.',',');el.textContent=prefix+out+suffix;if(t<1)requestAnimationFrame(tick);}requestAnimationFrame(tick);});},{threshold:.6});
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-counter]').forEach(el=>counterObserver.observe(el));

  const revealOnce=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(e=>{if(e.isIntersecting){e.target.classList.add('cinema-seen');revealOnce.unobserve(e.target);}}),{threshold:.2});
  document.querySelectorAll('.model-grid, footer').forEach(el=>revealOnce.observe(el));

  let ticking=false;
  function onScroll(){if(ticking)return;ticking=true;requestAnimationFrame(()=>{updateFlow();updateCompare();updateHowScroll();updateParallax();ticking=false;});}
  window.addEventListener('scroll',onScroll,{passive:true});window.addEventListener('resize',onScroll,{passive:true});
  updateFlow();updateCompare();updateHowScroll();updateParallax();
})();
</script>

<script id="mobile-official-behavior">
(()=>{
  const body=document.body;
  const burger=document.querySelector('.hamburger');
  const menu=document.querySelector('.mobile-menu');
  const closeMenu=()=>{
    body.classList.remove('menu-open');
    if(burger){burger.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');burger.setAttribute('aria-label','Abrir menu');}
  };
  const syncMenuLabel=()=>{
    if(!burger)return;
    const open=body.classList.contains('menu-open');
    burger.setAttribute('aria-label',open?'Fechar menu':'Abrir menu');
  };
  if(burger){
    burger.addEventListener('click',()=>requestAnimationFrame(syncMenuLabel));
  }
  document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')closeMenu();});
  document.addEventListener('click',e=>{
    if(!body.classList.contains('menu-open')||!menu||!burger)return;
    if(!menu.contains(e.target)&&!burger.contains(e.target))closeMenu();
  });
  window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{if(innerWidth>1024)closeMenu();},{passive:true});

  // Mobile/tablet: reveal the attention box only when card 03 enters the reading zone.
  const flow=document.querySelector('[data-flow-story]');
  const third=flow?.querySelectorAll('[data-flow-step]')?.[2];
  if(flow&&third){
    const obs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
      entries.forEach(entry=>{
        if(innerWidth<=1024 && entry.isIntersecting && entry.intersectionRatio>=0.45){
          flow.classList.add('note-active');
        }
      });
    },{threshold:[.45,.6]});
    obs.observe(third);
  }

  // Avoid decoding/playing the mid-page hero video while it is off screen.
  const methodVideo=document.querySelector('.how-hero-video');
  if(methodVideo){
    const videoObs=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>{
      entries.forEach(entry=>{
        if(entry.isIntersecting){methodVideo.play().catch(()=>{});}
        else{methodVideo.pause();}
      });
    },{rootMargin:'120px 0px',threshold:.05});
    videoObs.observe(methodVideo);
  }
})();
</script>

</body>
